parts.name: 12V 1A DC power adapter (5.5x2.1)
parts.notes: UL listed plug-in adapter; 12 W is plenty for a 3-7 W 12 V LED bulb, so no fuse needed. Search: 12V 1A power supply 5.5x2.1 UL

parts.name: DC jack screw-terminal adapter
parts.notes: 5.5x2.1 female barrel to screw terminal (10 pack ~$8). Search: DC female barrel jack screw terminal adapter

parts.name: KCD1 rocker switch
parts.notes: 21x15 mm SPST ON-OFF, snaps into a 19.2x13.2 cutout (pack price). Search: KCD1-101 rocker switch 2 pin

parts.name: Lamp wire 2-core 18 AWG
parts.notes: ~1 m, runs up the lamp pipe to your 12 V lamp head. Search: 18 AWG 2 conductor lamp wire

parts.name: 1/8 IPS lamp pipe
parts.notes: 3 in threaded lamp pipe nipple, 1/8 IPS (10.3 mm OD). Search: 1/8 IPS threaded lamp pipe 3 inch

parts.name: Lamp pipe lock nuts
parts.notes: 1/8 IPS hex lock nuts, one each side of the top. Search: 1/8 IPS lamp lock nut

parts.name: Rubber feet 12.7 mm
parts.notes: Self-adhesive bumpers 12.7 x 3.5 mm (3M Bumpon SJ5302 class); they cover the screw heads

parts.name: M3×10 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 10mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: Two lamp-wire joints are soldered to the rocker switch's spade lugs.
